label: Grok Build CLI
reason: Official Grok Build CLI docs describe repository instruction discovery. No sealed resolver revision exists. Not a public --reality. Not the Grok model. Cursor Composer, GLM, and Llama remain model names or hosts, not this surface.

evidence.claim: Grok Build CLI loads project-rule Markdown from every directory from the repository root down to the working directory, with deeper files taking precedence on conflicts.

Within each directory the Grok Build CLI reads AGENTS.md, Agents.md, AGENT.md, CLAUDE.md, Claude.md, and CLAUDE.local.md, plus every *.md file in .grok/rules/ (.claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ are read for compatibility with this CLI, not as Cursor editor or Claude Code realities).
Grok Build CLI skips instruction files ignored by .gitignore.
A nested AGENTS.md scopes to its subtree.
